props.gloss_en: the earlier generations made their Torah fixed and their work occasional, and both endured in their hands
the later generations, who made their work fixed and their Torah occasional -- neither endured in their hands
the earlier generations would bring their produce in by way of the main gate
so as to obligate [the produce] in tithes
the later generations bring their produce in by way of roofs, courtyards and enclosures
so as to exempt [the produce] from tithes
R' Yannai: tevel is not obligated in tithes until it sees the face of the house
as it is said: 'I have removed the holy from the house' (Deut 26:13)
R' Yochanan: even a courtyard fixes [produce for tithes]
as it is said: 'and they shall eat within your gates and be satisfied' (Deut 26:12)
